$comment: Per-fork config consumed by scripts/substitute-config-placeholders.sh. Copy this file to .gembaflow-config.json and fill in your values, then run /bootstrap-workflow or substitute-config-placeholders.sh directly. The three fields are substituted into {{org}} / {{bot.worker}} / {{bot.reviewer}} placeholders inside .claude/commands/*.md. See docs/PLATFORM-GUIDE.md for the templating convention.

workshop.$comment: Workshop mode — conditions agent behavior for one-day facilitated workshop cohorts (pattern-first bias, locked Next.js + Supabase stack, compressed iteration zero, facilitator-owned infra fence). Absent block or enabled: false means ZERO behavior change — leave it disabled unless a facilitator provisioned this repo for a cohort. When enabling, set cohort to the cohort slug, e.g. "2026-10-nashville". See docs/PLATFORM-GUIDE.md § "Workshop mode".
